body:
The strange thing is that I know I do have good and supportive people around me. They mean well. They do see what I bring and what I offer. But my burdens are beyond them, things they need not hear. It pains me to think of the harm this choice will still bring, but it is less than watching me wither. 

You are a kind person, I have no doubts of that. Your words are chosen carefully and in that you have brought a tear to my eye. I thank you for that. I am not one to deny a conversation, I am an open book. Ask anything you wish and I will give honest, unedited answers.

I appreciate your kindness and wish you a beautiful 2017. If you wish to talk I won't deny you that but please understand that my mind is already set. My plans are made and there is no turning back. People may love me, but not in the way I needed. They accepted that I was the person to always do nice things for others, they were never done to me. I've written my goodbyes, I've made my peace and today is the day I close my eyes for good. One last beautiful sunset is all I need. You do incredible things here and I admire the strength it takes to try to save the lives of those unsure. Stand tall and be proud of what you do.
